messages:
maya: quick check on small UX tweak for creds table — adding breadcrumb-like chips when users select mixed types (e.g., 2 keys · 1 token). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique123/cred-chips

owen: +1 but note backend nuance: tokens need server regen, keys can be client-only. UI should mark token items as "server-regen" so users know extra steps may be required.

li: a11y point: chips must be keyboard-focusable and have accessible names, e.g., "3 API keys selected" and "1 service token (server regen) selected". also ensure contrast for chip text meets AA.

samira: copy idea: for mixed selection header use: "Selected: 3 credentials (2 keys, 1 token)" — then secondary line: "Tokens will be regenerated on the server; others are rotated client-side." CTA text: "Rotate and download CSV" vs "Rotate (no download)".

maya: design questions: (1) should the chips be clickable to filter selection to that type? (2) if clicked, should table auto-scroll to first item?

owen: clickable chips are useful. make click behavior filter selection; auto-scroll to first matching row is fine but ensure it doesn't steal focus unexpectedly.

li: if chip click changes focus, announce "Filtered to service tokens, 1 of 1 visible" in an aria-live region.

samira: small tone nudge for warning copy: prefer helpful over scary — e.g., "We9ll create new credentials; download them now — secrets are shown only once."

dena-bot: quick lab note: 6 participants, when chips were non-interactive 4/6 missed that mixed selection implied different backend behavior. interactive chips resolved confusion.

maya: ok I9ll update figma to make chips interactive + add aria-live string and tweak copy. tagging @owen @li for final signoff before tickets. :sparkles:
